snippet.title: C64 Longplay: The Captive
snippet.description:
First time anybody's put a walkthrough up for this, apparently. There's the end screen at the c64endings site but it didn't show how they got there. 

The game doesn't look like much and has a rather jarring rendition of one the Fantasia themes (I forget which), but it's a pretty good challenge. It seems to be based on the '60s TV show The Prisoner. The only real pain-the-arse is that some of the enemies appear out of nowhere killing you instantly, and you have only the one life.

At 17:20 are parts that I missed out (red herrings and more of the final location) and some death scenes.

Published: 1985, Mastertronic
Everything else: Nigel P. Johnstone

REVIEW: https://archive.org/details/zzapp_64_issue_004_600dpi/page/n41/mode/2up
